entities.name: Cohabitation Revolution
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Sweden led the cohabitation revolution — by 2020, over 60% of Swedish first children are born to unmarried cohabiting parents. Across the West, cohabitation has replaced marriage as the first union for most couples. Some countries (France's PACS, UK civil partnerships) created legal alternatives to marriage.
